categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case via prompt payment made by the offender. Advances 'Maximize timely fine revenue' (Make +100) and 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost' (Help +50). Judged against indicator id=114 (Average time to case closure).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative task id=12 as observed frequently in the narrative sample (e.g., variant V0002).

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through payment received after penalties or enforcement steps have been initiated. Advances 'Maximize timely fine revenue' (Help +50). Judged against indicator id=114 (Average time to case closure).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative task id=13, evidenced by variants where payment occurs following notifications and added penalties (e.g., variant V0004).

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution handled via an administrative appeal submitted to the Prefecture. Preserves offender due-process rights (Help +50) while negatively impacting administrative costs and timely revenue (SomeNegative -25). Judged against indicator id=113 (Time to appeal filing, Prefecture).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative task id=14, supported by variants showing activities related to date insertion, sending, receiving results, and notifying results regarding the Prefecture appeal (e.g., variant V0008).

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution handled through a judicial appeal submitted to the Judge. Strongly preserves offender due-process rights (Make +100) but hurts administrative costs (Hurt -50). Judged against indicator id=175 (Time to appeal filing, Judge).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative task id=19, identified in variants containing 'Appeal to Judge' activities (e.g., variant V0103).

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Resolution through coercive credit collection measures. Advances timely revenue (Help +50) but hurts administrative and enforcement costs (Hurt -50). Judged against indicator id=114 (Average time to case closure).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative task id=20, observed in multiple variants ending with 'Send for Credit Collection' after penalties (e.g., variant V0001).
